title: Explainability-Based Token Replacement on LLM-Generated Text
description: Code, contestant models, and analysis for the explainability-based token-replacement experiments on AI-generated-text detectors. SHAP and LIME identify the tokens most influential to detector decisions; those tokens are then systematically replaced on the CLIN33 and AuTexTification corpora to expose adversarial weaknesses and pathways to greater robustness. Archived snapshot for the v1.0-thesis release accompanying the doctoral thesis Let Me Explain! Explainable NLP for Understanding Large Language Models (Utrecht University, 2026).
